description: Lists the Notion AI meeting notes of meetings the connected Notion user attended, the newest at the top, created on or after a date and optionally on or before another, and optionally only those whose title contains some text. Each note carries its id, title, the meeting's start and end time, its attendees (names where Notion gives them), its status, the AI summary and the notes as text, and action_items: every to-do in the summary and notes with whether it is checked, and every list item under a heading that says action items or next steps. The transcript is left out unless include_transcript is true. The text of one answer is held to max_body_chars together (default 100,000): when there is more, the oldest notes keep their title and times but not their text, and left_out lists their ids. Notion returns at most 50 notes and no cursor; has_more true means more notes match than were returned, and a narrower date range reads the rest. Notes still being transcribed or summarized come back with their status and no summary. A workspace without Notion AI meeting notes answers with a sentence saying so.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

include_transcript.description: Whether each note carries its transcript as text. Default false.

limit.description: How many notes, from 1 to 50. Default 10.

max_body_chars.description: The text of all notes in one answer, together, in characters. Default 100,000, at most 200,000.

since.description: Notes created on or after this day: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or one of today, yesterday, one_week_ago. Default yesterday.

title.description: Only notes whose title contains this text.

until.description: Notes created on or before this day: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or one of today, yesterday, one_week_ago. Absent means up to now.

name: notion-mcp__notion_list_meeting_notes
